name: FIPPA-Licensed Foreign Investor Work and Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Must obtain a Foreign Investment Promotion and Protection Act (FIPPA) license, issued by the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Finance -- there is no formal requirement to hold a permit before investing, but a FIPPA license is required to access the associated work/residence permit and legal protections. Applicants may apply at any time, including before capital transfer, during transfer, or even after the investment is already made.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a FIPPA license from the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Finance's Organization for Investment, Economic and Technical Assistance of Iran (OIETAI).

sources.title: Karimi Law Firm (Iran-focused private legal practice) -- FIPPA Protections and Incentives: a FIPPA license (signed by the Minister of Economic Affairs) grants the investor a 3-year work and residence permit, extendable to family members and employees; no minimum investment amount is specified; application can be made at any stage of the investment
